MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 28
   C. 33
   D. 22

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 14
   D. 12

4. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 33

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

7. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

8. Solve for x: x + 5 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 5
   C. 11
   D. 10

9. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4

   C. 16
   D. 8

10. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 12

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 45
   B. 18
   C. 30
   D. 36

12. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

13. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

14. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

15. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 4

16. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

17. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 1
   D. 20

18. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 56

   D. 26

21. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³

22. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)

23. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)

24. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)

25. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)

26. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
